name: LValueData.kernelForm_invariant
summary: Left: automorphy of the theta kernel; right: Υ is fixed by the elements of K₀ reducing to 1 at M.

steps.claim: Prove the two invariances: for an element k of the group (left rational, or right in the level) and every g, compare the kernel forms at each h.
steps.lean: constructor <;> rintro _ ⟨k, e⟩ g <;> simp only [kernelForm] <;> congr 2 with h : 1

steps.claim: Left: the theta kernel is invariant under rational points (`LValueData.liftKernel`, its third property).
steps.lean: simpa [e, weightRep] using! X.liftKernel.3 k 1 (X.liftKernel.ω (g, h) X.auxPair.auxDatum) 1

steps.claim: Right: for k in the chosen level, the Weil action of k fixes Υ (`AuxPair.pairWeil_upsilon` with trivial characters at M), so the kernel values agree.
steps.lean: have := congr(X.kernelValue 1 $(X.auxPair.pairWeil_upsilon k 1 1 (by simp_all)) g h); aesop
